name: date_same_numeric_exact
spec_quote: Same numbers in any order/format: want "06/14/2027" matches got "06/14/2027", "2027-06-14" and "14/06/2027".

name: date_same_month_word_vs_mm_dd
spec_quote: A want written with the month as a word and a day ("June 14, 2027", "Jun 14 2027", "14 June 2027", "June 14th, 2027") or as YYYY-MM-DD names that full date: it matches got "06/14/2027" (and the other forms above), never another day, month or year ("06/15/2027", "07/14/2027", "06/14/2028").

name: date_same_day_first_month_word
spec_quote: A want written with the month as a word and a day ("June 14, 2027", "Jun 14 2027", "14 June 2027", "June 14th, 2027") or as YYYY-MM-DD names that full date: it matches got "06/14/2027" (and the other forms above), never another day, month or year ("06/15/2027", "07/14/2027", "06/14/2028").

name: date_same_wrong_day
spec_quote: it matches got "06/14/2027" (and the other forms above), never another day, month or year ("06/15/2027", "07/14/2027", "06/14/2028").

name: date_same_month_year_any_day
spec_quote: A want given as "<Month name> <year>" (e.g. "December 2027", "Jun 2027") names a month: it matches a got date with three numbers when that month and year appear (e.g. "12/01/2027", "12/31/2027", "2027-12-01"), whatever the day.

name: date_same_month_year_wrong_month
spec_quote: It does not match another month or year ("11/01/2027", "12/01/2028").

name: date_same_nondate_same_text_case
spec_quote: A want that is not a date at all ("Summer 2027", "ASAP") matches only exactly the same text (case and spaces ignored).

name: date_same_empty_got
spec_quote: An empty got never matches.

name: date_value_month_word
spec_quote: A full date in any unambiguous form → [MM/DD/YYYY with two-digit month and day, null]: "June 14, 2027" → ["06/14/2027", null]; ...

name: date_value_short_numeric
spec_quote: A full date in any unambiguous form → [MM/DD/YYYY with two-digit month and day, null]: ... "6/4/2027" → ["06/04/2027", null]; ...

name: date_value_iso
spec_quote: A full date in any unambiguous form → [MM/DD/YYYY with two-digit month and day, null]: ... "2027-06-14" → ["06/14/2027", null]; ...

name: date_value_day_first_word_month
spec_quote: A full date in any unambiguous form → [MM/DD/YYYY with two-digit month and day, null]: ... "14 June 2027" → ["06/14/2027", null]; ...

name: date_value_month_year_kept
spec_quote: "<Month name> <year>" ("December 2027") is kept as it is: ["December 2027", null].

name: date_value_day_first_above_12_refused
spec_quote: Anything else → [null, reason] where reason is a non-empty text: ... a day-first date whose first number is above 12 ("14/06/2027"), ...

name: date_value_nonexistent_refused
spec_quote: Anything else → [null, reason] where reason is a non-empty text: ... a date that does not exist ("02/30/2027", "June 31, 2027"), ...

name: pick_school_exact_the_prefix
spec_quote: An option equal to the school after that normalisation wins ("The University of Chicago" and "university of chicago" are both the school "University of Chicago"); when several are equal, the first of them.

name: pick_school_exact_lowercase_option
spec_quote: An option equal to the school after that normalisation wins ("The University of Chicago" and "university of chicago" are both the school "University of Chicago"); when several are equal, the first of them.

name: pick_school_multiple_equal_first
spec_quote: when several are equal, the first of them.

name: pick_school_unique_containment
spec_quote: Otherwise, when exactly one option contains the whole normalised school name as a run of whole words (e.g. "University of Chicago (Chicago, IL)" for "University of Chicago"), that option.

name: pick_school_two_containments_null
args: University of Chicago Booth School of Business
spec_quote: Two or more such options (e.g. "University of Chicago Booth School of Business" and "University of Chicago Laboratory Schools") → null.

name: pick_school_shared_words_null
spec_quote: A name that only shares words is not the school: "Loyola University Chicago" and "Chicago State University" are not "University of Chicago"; ...

name: pick_school_illinois_shared_words_null
spec_quote: "University of Illinois Chicago" is not "University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign".

name: pick_school_empty_options
spec_quote: An empty option list or an empty school → null.

name: submit_errors_red_box_with_labels
args:
Your form needs corrections
Missing entry for required field: School
Please select a valid date
Education*
School*
Submit Application
spec_quote: A line "Missing entry for required field: <Field>" anywhere on the page gives "<Field>" (the field name alone, trimmed). After the heading "Your form needs corrections", each following non-empty line that reads as an error message ... is part of the list; the first non-empty line that is not an error message ends the list.

name: submit_errors_heading_no_error_line
args:
Your form needs corrections
School*
Submit Application
spec_quote: The heading with no error line after it gives ["form needs corrections"].

name: submit_errors_thank_you_page
args:
Thank you for applying
Your application has been submitted
spec_quote: Return what the box lists, in order; [] when the page shows no such errors (for example the thank-you page, or the form before Submit): ... text such as "Thank you for applying" is not an error.

name: submit_errors_form_before_submit
spec_quote: [] when the page shows no such errors (for example the thank-you page, or the form before Submit). A field label that ends in "*" (a required marker) is not an error.

name: submit_errors_duplicate_field_once
args:
Your form needs corrections
Missing entry for required field: School
Missing entry for required field: School
Please enter a valid date
spec_quote: A "Missing entry …" line in the list gives the field name as above; other lines are returned whole (trimmed). ... the same field is listed once.

name: submit_errors_non_error_ends_list
args:
Your form needs corrections
Missing entry for required field: School
Thank you for applying
Please select a valid date
spec_quote: the first non-empty line that is not an error message ends the list. ... text such as "Thank you for applying" is not an error.

name: submit_errors_other_messages_trimmed
args:
Your form needs corrections
  Invalid entry for Date of Birth  
  This field is required  
  Must be at least 18  
  Submit
expect: Invalid entry for Date of Birth
spec_quote: each following non-empty line that reads as an error message (it contains "required", "invalid", "must", "please enter", "please select", "not valid" or "missing", case ignored) is part of the list; ... other lines are returned whole (trimmed).
